Compared in game against act4/diab/walls.dt1 (brick ruin walls, a foreign kit), expansion/baallair/walls.dt1 (stone brick), expansion/siege/cliff.dt1 (ice-capped rock) and the old expansion/icecave/interior.dt1 (white frost at the base). Stock has no piece for the lower variant 19 (orientation 4): the pass turns an orientation-3 piece half a circle about its tile for it
